description: Single source of truth for the status-check names that branch protection marks as *required*. The scripts/src/check-ci-passthrough-names.ts guard asserts every name below is (a) produced by some real guard job AND (b) covered by a passthrough companion, across ALL workflows in .github/workflows/. If a whole safety workflow is deleted or renamed so that a required name no longer has a producer, the guard fails loudly instead of letting the required-check deadlock silently return. When you add or remove a required check in branch protection, update this list in the same PR.
advisoryDescription: Check names produced by a real guard job in a passthrough-scheme (safety) workflow that are INTENTIONALLY not marked required in branch protection — i.e. they run and report but a red result does not block merges. Listing a name here is an explicit acknowledgement that the job is advisory. The guard flags any real safety-guard check that is in NEITHER requiredChecks NOR this list, so a brand-new safety job that someone forgot to make required cannot silently ship toothless. Keep this list minimal; prefer making a real safety check required.
